reviews.author: Garret Gay
reviews.text: Affordable auto repair and their crew are amazing. I received an affordable oil change and rotated my tires for me because the tread was low in the front. Tim, the owner, is the most honest and transparent mechanic you will meet with only looking out for what’s best for you. You’re in extremely capable hands here.

reviews.author: Loretta “OnePupil9” Crosby
reviews.text: After three months of chasing down an engine light for my DMV inspection, going through 4 to 5 different mechanics with no real answers, I was honestly at my wits' end. With another deadline approaching, I took my car to Affordable Auto Repair as a last resort before applying for a waiver. That’s when Tim stepped in and did what no one else had done: he found the actual problem and fixed it. Not only that, his quoted price came in about 34% lower than a competitor’s quote for the same job. That alone got my attention, but what really stood out was his integrity. There’s a sign in his office about honesty in the small things reflecting honesty in the big ones, and I could tell he lives that. He explained everything in plain terms, no confusion, no runaround. He’s personable, professional, and clearly takes pride in doing the job right. Yes, I had to wait about a week for an appointment, but now I understand why. When someone does honest, quality work, people line up. Tim has earned my trust, and he’ll have my business going forward.

reviews.author: Alex Votary
reviews.text: Excellent shop! They diagnosed the issue quickly and got it taken care of. No up charging or funny business. Highly recommend. They stay busy, so you may want to call ahead for an appointment, but it's worth the wait.
